items.changes: cancels LEAVE_DECIDE_KIND; leave canceled into leaves (leave.ts:1047)
items.downstream: no decision comes; offset and enrolledTerms as they were
items.tests: tests/leave.test.ts ‘can be called off while it waits, and the decision never comes’ (the New Haven student, born in New York)
items.issue: Through the command, asked and called off with confirmation: the decision never comes, the leave is on the record as canceled, and the program goes on at its terms (offset 0, both terms enrolled) through the clock.

items.entry: The leave panel’s Appeal To The Dean, on a leave the dean imposed (StudyPlanPanels.tsx:77)
items.reads: a mandatory leave, not appealed, by its appealBy
items.changes: mandatory.appeal; APPEAL_KIND after the dean’s working days (leave.ts:963)
items.downstream: the appeal’s decision: rescindable (cleared, and half the term left) restores the term’s courses and classes (rescind); else upheld
items.explanation: ‘Your Leave Is Overturned’ or ‘Your Appeal Is Turned Down’
items.tests: tests/school-paths.test.ts ‘PLAYER JOURNEY: assessed on function, recommended, imposed by the dean, appealed and overturned...’, ‘an appeal from a student cleared with less than half the term left leaves the leave standing’, ‘an appeal turned down leaves the leave standing; too late, it’s refused’ (the New Haven student, born in New York; the hospital stays that bring the assessment put in by hand)
items.issue: Through the command and the clock, an appeal from a student cleared early in the term rescinds the leave, restores the term’s courses and classes count again; cleared too late, or not cleared, it’s upheld; a second appeal is refused. The crisis that brings Yale Health’s assessment is put in by hand.

items.entry: The leave panel’s Give Notice Of Return (StudyPlanPanels.tsx:81)
items.reads: a leave on, no notice given, by noticeBy; a medical leave’s clearance (clearedToReturn)
items.downstream: LEAVE_NOTICE_KIND dismisses only without it; the return term begins the program again (TERM_KIND, mustRegister)
items.explanation: The leave panel; ‘Two Weeks To Give Notice’
items.tests: tests/leave.test.ts ‘asks, waits, leaves the term, keeps Yale Health...’, ‘PLAYER JOURNEY: asked on the third day of spring classes...’ (no notice, dismissed); tests/journey-second-year-return.test.ts ‘asks in the summer after year one...’; tests/school-paths.test.ts ‘keeps the first class whole and played forward...’ (the New Haven student, born in New York)
items.issue: Through the command and the clock, notice is refused without a physician’s clearance after a medical leave, given once, and the student is back at the return term with the courses left; without it the leave ends in dismissal.

items.downstream: registered(), which classes and shifts read
items.explanation: The Register line; the hold’s refusal
items.tests: tests/leave.test.ts ‘asks, waits, leaves the term, keeps Yale Health...’; tests/journey-second-year-return.test.ts ‘asks in the summer after year one...’ (the fall back’s courses attended once registered) (the New Haven student, born in New York)
items.issue: Through the command, a student back from a leave registers once, and the fall back’s courses are attended through the clock. No test refuses it for a hold.

items.reads: a leave on, no Affiliate cover, by affiliateBy; affiliateQuote; the bank
items.changes: pays; leave.affiliate; the lapse closed (school.uncovered); repriceCare (leave.ts:1104)
items.downstream: coverOn back to the day student cover ended; care had in the lapse billed again as Yale Health’s
items.explanation: The quote in the confirmation; ‘Care Credited’
items.tests: tests/leave.test.ts ‘PLAYER JOURNEY: asked on the third day of spring classes...’; tests/defects-g8-2.test.ts ‘shows and charges the leave’s own three terms, the same figure’ (the New Haven student, born in New York; money put in by hand)
items.issue: Through the command, Affiliate cover is bought for both terms less the fee paid, Yale Health covers back to the lapse, and a bill had in it is brought down.

items.reads: confirm; the fifteenth day of classes (early)
items.changes: standing withdrawn; the place given up; a leave ended with it; an early withdrawal cancels Yale Health to the insurance term’s start (school.ts:3570)
items.downstream: TERM_KIND called off; coverOn; care in a canceled term billed again; the F-1 grace and OPT (permission.ts)
items.tests: tests/leave.test.ts ‘ends the leave with the place’, ‘cancels Yale Health back to the insurance term’s start...’; tests/student-experience.test.ts ‘PLAYER JOURNEY: a withdrawal by the fifteenth day of classes cancels Yale Health back to the term...’, ‘a withdrawal later in the term keeps Yale Health thirty days, with nothing refunded’; tests/defects-g8-4.test.ts ‘PLAYER JOURNEY: in a fall it goes back to 1 August...’; tests/journey-class-left-behind.test.ts (the New Haven student, born in New York)
items.issue: Through the command, withdrawal ends the place and a leave with it, calls off the next term, and by the fifteenth day of classes cancels Yale Health back to the term’s start, bills the care had in it again and refunds the premium; later, cover runs thirty days.

items.entry: A course’s Make Up A Session (SchoolWorkspace.tsx:566)
items.reads: makeUpRefusal: an Incomplete in its month, in New Haven, two hours free
items.changes: a session made up (courserecord.ts:178); the course passed on the last
items.downstream: degreeShortfall; conferIfReady, a degree waiting on it conferred
items.tests: tests/student-experience.test.ts ‘PLAYER JOURNEY: ill for five weeks of classes in the first fall, an Incomplete in a course, made up in its sessions, and passed’, ‘an Incomplete at Commencement keeps them from it, and the degree comes when it’s made up...’ (the New Haven student, born in New York; the hospital stay and, in the second, the last term’s record put in by hand)
items.issue: Through the command, an Incomplete left by an illness is made up session by session and passed, and one open at Commencement confers the held degree once made up.

items.entry: A course’s Ask For A Month More (SchoolWorkspace.tsx:567)
items.downstream: the month’s end, which makes an Incomplete Permanent past dueBy
items.tests: tests/student-experience.test.ts ‘is extended once by a month, and not again’ (the Incomplete settled by hand)
items.issue: Through the command, the month runs a month more, a second asking is refused, and past the old date the course is still Incomplete through the clock.

items.reads: repeatRefusal: a course failed at the year’s end, or a last year’s within thirty days; not past nine semesters; not a year repeated before
items.downstream: granted: offset and classOf (academicTerm, the curriculum), the attempts kept and the degree reading the best (degreeShortfall), the next term put on the calendar for a last year’s; the I-20 extended
items.tests: tests/leave.test.ts ‘PLAYER JOURNEY: a first year failed is repeated on request...’, ‘PLAYER JOURNEY: a last year failed waits thirty days for a repeat...’; tests/papers-transitions.test.ts (the New Haven student, born in New York; the course failed set by hand)
items.issue: Through the command and the clock, a year failed is repeated: the program set back two terms, the year’s courses meeting again, the first attempts kept; a last year’s is put back on the calendar and billed past six. The degree reading the best attempt is checked on attempts set by hand.

items.entry: Finishing The Degree: Call Off The Request, then Call It Off (StudyPlanPanels.tsx:209)
items.reads: a repeat pending; confirm, with cancelRepeatWarning
items.downstream: no decision; a last year’s REPEAT_DUE_KIND withholds the degree if nothing else is asked by its date
items.tests: tests/defects-g8-2.test.ts ‘asks first, with what calling it off leaves, and calls it off only on Call It Off’ (pressed on the rendered panel)
items.issue: Pressed on the rendered panel, through the engine: refused without confirmation with its warning, and canceled. No test checks what follows: that the chair’s decision doesn’t come, and the degree withheld at the date when nothing else is asked.

items.entry: Finishing The Degree: Ask For An Additional Term (StudyPlanPanels.tsx:199)
items.reads: extraRefusal: after the last year’s evaluation, what it left unpassed, in its thirty days
items.downstream: granted: school.extra, the term on the calendar, coursesFor meeting only the courses retaken, the I-20 extended; refused past nine semesters
items.tests: tests/school-paths.test.ts ‘retakes a first-year fall course in a fall after the third year...’; tests/defects-g8-3.test.ts ‘in an additional term, shows only the courses retaken...’; tests/defects-g10-1.test.ts ‘an additional term retakes its course, which meets next...’ (the New Haven student, born in New York; the sixth term’s record set by hand)
items.issue: Through the command and the clock, an additional term is granted for the course unpassed, only it meets, it’s billed past six and confers in December. The sixth term’s evaluation and the retake’s pass are set by hand.

items.entry: Terms And Award: Owed On Your Yale Account, Pay From Your Bank (StudyPlanPanels.tsx:250)
items.reads: accountOwed; the bank; no more than is owed
items.downstream: the hold lifted once paid (registration, the diploma); conferIfReady, a degree held for it conferred
items.explanation: ‘The Financial Hold Is Lifted’; ‘Your MFA Is Conferred’
items.tests: tests/leave.test.ts ‘PLAYER JOURNEY: a last year failed waits thirty days for a repeat, then bills the seventh term...’, ‘PLAYER JOURNEY: graduation after a repeated year...’; tests/school-paths.test.ts ‘retakes a first-year fall course in a fall after the third year...’ (the New Haven student, born in New York; money put in by hand)
items.issue: Through the command, a term billed past six is paid in parts, the hold lifting on the last, and a diploma held for the account is conferred once it’s paid. A balance comes only from a term past the sixth.

items.entry: Terms And Award: Ask For An Aid Review (StudyPlanPanels.tsx:267)
items.reads: aidReviewRefusal: once, at school, a seventh term coming
items.downstream: the term’s billing past six, which reads a decided review: no tuition where a medical leave made the extra terms, living aid where need was found
items.tests: tests/school-paths.test.ts ‘a medical leave behind it earns the aid office’s exception to tuition’, ‘retakes a first-year fall course...’; tests/defects-g8-2.test.ts ‘shows a term the aid office waived as the six were...’ (the engine bills nothing for it), ‘PLAYER JOURNEY: is refused to a student back from a leave and within the six...’ (the New Haven student, born in New York; the leave and the terms begun set by hand)
items.issue: Through the command and the clock, the aid office excepts tuition where a medical leave made the extra terms, and the term then begun bills nothing for it; without one, it bills tuition. Asked twice, refused.

items.entry: School, Shifts And Pay: Ask For Conversion To Grant Aid (StudyPlanPanels.tsx:295)
items.reads: conversionRefusal: need-based aid, not on leave, convertible hours (assigned hours excused or never assigned), one request at a time
items.changes: a conversion request to the next January or May processing (school.ts:3011)
items.downstream: the grant paid at the work-study rate, recorded as the year’s scholarship, which the return reads
items.tests: tests/work-limits.test.ts ‘PLAYER JOURNEY: assigned hours missed ill, asked to be converted, paid in January as a taxable scholarship; refused to a student with no aid’
items.issue: Through the command and the clock, an assigned shift called in sick is converted, paid in January at the work-study rate as a scholarship and on the year’s earnings record the return reads; refused to a student with no aid and a second time.

findings.what: Coursework showings (band/overall, repeated Unready work, missed or lapsed assignments) never reach the term evaluation or standing; only that meeting's 0.85-1.2 growth weight. Teachers' notes read craft growth only. Repeated unprepared coursework produces "Still There" notes, never concern/warning.
findings.evidence: evaluate reads tally, termGrowth, casting/rep nights, breaches; no read of coursework.assignments or person.work
findings.suggestedFix: Fold the term's showings (mean overall or share Unready/missed) into evaluate() as run nights are, or say in the evaluation text that coursework is not weighed

findings.what: The Carlotta run (every first-year spring, lower half in second-year spring) plays 4-12 May, after the spring evaluation on the last class day (23 Apr); its nights are never read by any evaluation. Its missed calls land in a tally already evaluated and reset next term.
findings.evidence: run filter c.term===term && nights>=3 at evaluation time; CLASSES spring to 2027-04-23; carlotta [[5,4],[5,12]]
findings.suggestedFix: Evaluate after the term's production closes, or carry a run closing after the evaluation into the next term's

findings.what: Development history misses much growth: playNight/rehearse (every call and night), lab growth, a coursework step's trained skill (grow), and nerves' composure/presence nudges. The Profile look says "Nothing has moved it since the history began" for e.g. composure or classical that did move. These paths also bypass develop()'s same-day repeat and discipline lift.
findings.evidence: grow() and nudge() write craft/attrs directly, no recordDevelopment
findings.suggestedFix: Route through develop()/ordinary() or call recordDevelopment with the delta

findings.what: The director's run note "Work on your X" sets noteSkill/noteLevel, and cast() computes heeded and LastWork.nights, but castScore reads neither and nothing else does. SchoolWorkspace tells the player "How a run goes is read by the chair when casting you next" while the chair reads delivery (prep x condition), not the nights.
findings.evidence: heeded/lastWork.nights read only in tests (attributes-complete.test.ts:80, casting.test.ts:220)
findings.suggestedFix: Drop heeded/nights/noteSkill/noteLevel or give them a reader; reword the UI line to delivery

findings.what: Classmate.shown (classmateRun's judged quality) is written and read by nothing; a classmate's LastWork.delivery is their static reliability, not the run.
findings.evidence: only writer school.ts:1455; attributes-complete.test.ts:107-108 asserts only that it exists
findings.suggestedFix: Use the run's quality/delivery for their next casting, or remove the record

findings.what: Cabaret, Summer Cabaret and Rep runs accumulate nights and delivered, but cast() builds lastWork only from school.casting and evaluate() reads only casting/rep, so Cabaret/Summer quality reaches neither standing nor casting.
findings.evidence: c0 = school.casting only; run search [casting, rep]
findings.suggestedFix: Decide whether extracurricular runs count; if not, stop accumulating delivered on them

findings.what: school.filmed is set at graduation and read nowhere (what read it went 2026-10-09).
findings.suggestedFix: Remove or wire to a reader

findings.what: revision.band is kept "for the showcase (showcaseSceneSeen)", which no longer exists; Showing.score and Showing.parts are unread too. Present-tense comments falsified (also school.ts:542 "read by the showcase").
findings.evidence: grep showcaseSceneSeen: comment only; no reader of shown.score/parts/revision.band
findings.suggestedFix: Past-tense the comments; drop or display the fields

findings.what: A night is judged after its own playNight growth, so each performance is evaluated on craft the night itself just added.
findings.evidence: playNight(...) precedes reckonNight(...) in each branch

findings.what: The third year's solo showing (You Are The Creator) is never judged: no evaluation, band or work record, only scene growth.
findings.evidence: showing branch: nerves, grow, tire, return
findings.suggestedFix: Judge it with the scene/performance profile and record it

findings.what: Test name contradicts behavior: casting.test.ts "balances opportunity ... and good nights for it" asserts nights no longer count.

Untested behavior: school.respond choices (trust/bond/answers/tryBoth/boundary), school.read_feedback's gate on prepare, school.moment lapse, study_session effect, classmates' ability growth in class (growMateAbility).
findings.evidence: only journey tests call them, without asserting effects
findings.suggestedFix: Add mutation-sensitive tests for each effect
